meta.name: EMPAIA Workbench Client
meta.description: Runs xOpat as an EMPAIA Workbench v3 vendor app UI: reads the scope, token and backend URL from the workbench client, opens the examination's slides, syncs annotations with the workbench data API, and drives app jobs.

error.notEmbedded: The EMPAIA Workbench client is not available: this viewer is not embedded in a workbench.
error.notV3App: This app does not provide an EMPAIA App Description v3 (no 'io'/'modes' block). Only workbench v3 apps are supported.
error.noSession: The EMPAIA workbench session is not ready yet.
error.handshakeTimeout: The EMPAIA Workbench client did not send a scope, token and backend URL in time.
error.batchNotReady: There is no staged run for this slide.
error.modeNotRunnable: This analysis cannot be started from here.

io.notReady: The EMPAIA workbench session is not ready — changes were not sent.
io.createFailed: Could not save the annotation to the EMPAIA workbench.
io.updateFailed: Could not update the annotation in the EMPAIA workbench.
io.deleteFailed: Could not delete the annotation from the EMPAIA workbench.
io.readFailed: Could not load annotations from the EMPAIA workbench.
io.bundleFailed: Could not upload annotations to the EMPAIA workbench.
io.badBundle: The annotation payload could not be read.
io.unrepresentable: A "{{type}}" annotation has no EMPAIA equivalent and cannot be stored in this examination.
io.unrepresentableLocal: "{{type}}" annotations have no EMPAIA equivalent: they stay in this browser only and are lost on reload.
io.storageWriteFailed: Could not save data to the EMPAIA app storage.
io.storageReadFailed: Could not load data from the EMPAIA app storage.

blocked.noApp: The app description has not been read yet.
blocked.platformRun: Preprocessing analyses are started by the platform when the examination opens — their results are shown here, but there is nothing to start.
blocked.nonContainerized: This app performs this step inside its own interface, so it cannot be started from this viewer.
blocked.wsiCollection: This app analyses several slides in one run, which this viewer cannot do.
blocked.nestedRoiCollection: This app groups its regions of interest into nested collections, which this viewer cannot build.
blocked.roiShape: This app asks for a region shape this viewer cannot draw ({{type}}).
blocked.inputType: This app needs a "{{type}}" input ({{key}}) that this viewer cannot supply.
blocked.unreadableInput: The app declares an input ({{key}}) this viewer cannot read.
blocked.noWsi: This app declares no slide input for this step.
blocked.singleAndMulti: This app mixes single region inputs with region collection inputs.
blocked.sameInputTypes: This app declares several inputs of the same region type.
blocked.noSourceJob: This step is built on an earlier analysis, and none has finished on this slide yet.
